FIELDS.NAME: TalentLink Staffing Agency
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At TalentLink Staffing Agency, we specialize in connecting skilled professionals with employers across various industries, focusing primarily on permanent placements in non-regulated sectors. Our operations include thorough candidate screening processes that involve background checks, work eligibility verification, and credential assessments to ensure compliance with all applicable laws. We maintain all necessary state and federal licenses to operate legally, avoiding any potential regulatory violations. Our dedicated team uses secure and modern applicant tracking systems to protect both candidate and client data, in accordance with privacy regulations. We prioritize building strong working relationships with both clients and candidates through clear communications, including written contracts that outline the terms of service and responsibilities for both parties. Our goal is to provide exemplary staffing solutions while ensuring a professional and compliant operational standard.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in subcontracting placement services to unlicensed or unregistered third-party recruiters and confirms that it maintains all required state and federal licenses for its operations. Additionally, the agency verifies all candidate credentials and compliance for placements in regulated industries and conducts mandatory background checks and work eligibility verification for all placements.
